theme: Access & Onboarding -- the second of the ratified three-release Beta-1 path (v0.11 Operator Experience -> v0.12 Access & Onboarding -> v1.0 MVP Beta 1). Adds surfaces deliberately, so the release that freezes the API adds nothing. E-02: paired operator sessions (ADR-0068) -- the product's first revocable session, capability-narrowed to approvals@1, off by default. E-03: required + enforced deployment profiles (lan-only/vpn-first/dmz-first) closing the topology spec's installer clause. E-04: a first-run checklist derived from live state plus a loopback (self-SSH) demo target reaching a real governed action. E-05a: a Button component with real hover/active/focus-visible/disabled states, migrated across every presenting button in the product (E-05b ConfirmDialog CUT, recorded CEO decision). No new capability edge, actor class, credential path, egress path, or agent-plane change; the mcp-gateway stays keyless (SEC-20/40); no new third-party dependency (the QR encoder is vendored).

adrs.ADR-0068: Accepted 2026-08-02 -- Paired operator sessions: a fifth PASETO token tier (PairedTTL) with server-side per-request liveness (D4) -- the ONE declared divergence from ADR-0046's four stateless tiers; ADR-0046 itself is NOT edited, its seven-edge set and single-bootstrap-operator posture stand. The paired session is capability-narrowed to a single-sourced, versioned scope approvals@1 (D5) -- a scope WITHIN human-agent, not an eighth capability edge. One-time hashed pairing secret, fragment-carried (never touches the server in a URL), 120s TTL, single-use, redeemed in-tx (D6). Hand-rolled QR encoder + no ConfirmDialog dependency, both vendored, zero new npm package (D7). Deployment profiles implement ADR-0005's unmet installer clause with no ZTNA dependency (D1). Onboarding checklist derives from live state only (D8). Gate = WD-11 for pairing only, re-tested against the as-built, not inherited (D9). Pairing ships disabled by default, 404 when off, no oracle (D10). Fragment discipline -- new named components only; LimitParam/CursorParam/PageMeta untouched (D11). Extends ADR-0005/0046/0047/0051/0053/0062/0067; edits no Accepted ADR (G2-clean).

Latent since v0.1.0; found by T-118b's live proof, not by any test, because every SSH fixture in the product offered exactly one key type until then.
